SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT KEP_SEQ FROM KEPCON.IF_C_FILE_UC WHERE DOC_TYPE = 'RFQ_R' AND BUYER IN ('CNCHSG000x') AND IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY BUYER, KEY_NO, KEY_SEQ
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT f_split(data01,'^',2) AS PLANT , key_no as QUOTATION_NO , key_seq as QUOTATION_SEQ , f_split(data01,'^',1) as REVISION_NO , f_split(data01,'^',3) AS BUYER_ITEM_NO , to_number(f_split(data01,'^',4)) AS UNIT_PRICE01 , data02 AS REMARK , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS IF_DATE , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') AS IF_TIME FROM KEPCON.IF_C_FILE_UC WHERE KEP_SEQ = '$G_RS.KEP_SEQ$'
UPDATE KEPCON.IF_C_FILE_UC SET IF_FLAG = 'Y' , IF_DATE = to_char(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , IF_TIME = to_char(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE KEP_SEQ = '$G_RS.KEP_SEQ$'
UPDATE KEPCON.IF_C_FILE_UC SET IF_FLAG = 'E' , IF_DATE = to_char(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , IF_TIME = to_char(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE KEP_SEQ = '$G_RS.KEP_SEQ$'
